channel.title: Religion News Service - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Religion News Service (religionnews.com)

item.title: Why standing in solidarity with immigrants is an act of accompaniment in Catholic philosophy
item.description: Accompaniment, rooted in modern Catholic social thought, calls for putting the needs of the most vulnerable first.

item.title: Baptists have helped shape debate about religious freedom for over 400 years – up to today’s 10 Commandments laws
item.description: The phrase ‘separation of church and state’ dates back to a letter from Thomas Jefferson to a Baptist congregation.

item.title: ‘Flour war’ erupts in Greek seaside town as revelers celebrate the start of Lent
item.description: It’s an explosion of color that takes place every Clean Monday, an Orthodox Christian holiday marking the start of Lent, the 40-day period of fasting that ends on the Easter holiday, and the end of the carnival season that holds onto many of the country’s pre-Christian traditions.

item.title: Israeli settlers torch and deface a West Bank mosque during Ramadan
item.description: Worshippers arriving for the day's first prayers found the damage and a smoldering fire that spewed black smoke across the entrance of the Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq Mosque in the town of Tell, near Nablus, and stained the ornate doorway.

item.title: After anti-abortion backlash, Notre Dame professor declines director position
item.description: Catholic bishops, Notre Dame students and alumni and other anti-abortion Catholics had vocally opposed the appointment since it was announced Jan. 8.

item.title: Liberal Jews denounce bill to ban non-Orthodox prayers at Western Wall
item.description: ‘It literally criminalizes non-Orthodox prayer,’ said Rabbi Rick Jacobs, president of the Union for Reform Judaism in the U.S.

item.title: A Palestinian American talks to Tucker Carlson about how US evangelicals misunderstand Israel
item.description: Fares Abraham worries that Palestinian Christian communities across the Middle East, but especially in the West Bank, are in danger of disappearing.

item.title: Religious parents awarded $1.5M after Supreme Court win in LGBTQ+ books case
item.description: The settlement will signal to public schools that parents should have ‘the final say’ on their children’s education, wrote Eric Baxter, the plaintiffs’ attorney.

item.title: Ramadan-ing in a time of fear
item.description: How are Muslims making the most of this holy time without giving in to elevated worry and fear?

item.title: How American Jewish Immigrants Invented Childhood
item.description: Teddy bears. Lionel trains. Baseball cards. Curious George. Barbie. All were made by Jews.
